Akali.watch: Dodge the first projectile from Akali E Shuriken Flip. If it marks you, the second dash will follow, so dodge the projectile first, then close the distance with Galio E Justice Punch. You can’t dodge the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution by walking, and its second hit deals more damage based on your missing health. Charge Galio W Shield of Durand as she goes in to reduce the damage.
Akali.build: Build magic resistance early with Spectre's Cowl or Spirit Visage to counter Akali’s main damage. Magic resistance helps Galio both defensively and offensively. Build enough health to stay out of Akali R Perfect Execution’s execute range.
Akali.fight: When Akali’s attack comes in, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to reduce the damage, then retaliate with a taunt.
Akali.combo: When Akali E Shuriken Flip’s first projectile misses and Akali is outside her shroud, knock her up with Galio E Justice Punch. Before the knock-up ends, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to chain a brief taunt, then place Galio Q Winds of War’s vortex on her. After landing your abilities, follow up with Galio P Colossal Smash’s empowered attack.
Akali.escape: Don’t go in just because Akali W Twilight Shroud or E Shuriken Flip is on cooldown. In particular, wait until Akali R Perfect Execution is unavailable and she has also used another escape, then close the distance with Galio E Justice Punch and taunt with W Shield of Durand.
Akali.teamfight: If Akali dives an ally, start Galio R Hero's Entrance to shield them before you arrive, then use W Shield of Durand after landing to peel Akali away from them. Landing where allied crowd control has caught Akali is effective. Don’t force an engage to save an ally who is already dying.

Ahri.watch: If Ahri E Charm hits you, you can easily take her entire follow-up combo, so dodge it with minions between you. Ahri Q Orb of Deception can hit you on its return, and the return damage is true damage, so keep moving outside its return path even after dodging the initial cast.
Ahri.build: Build magic resistance first against Ahri’s main damage, and get Spectre's Cowl or Spirit Visage early. Ahri Q Orb of Deception’s return damage is true damage and isn’t reduced by magic resistance, so you also need health. Prioritize a way to interrupt or remove Ahri E Charm.
Ahri.fight: Engage for a trade right after Ahri E Charm goes on cooldown. When Ahri’s combo comes in, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to reduce the damage, then retaliate with a taunt. If your abilities hit, follow up with Galio P Colossal Smash’s empowered attack.
Ahri.laning: After pushing the wave toward the enemy turret, look for an opportunity to influence another lane with Galio R Hero's Entrance.
Ahri.escape: The window to engage is when you dodge Ahri E Charm or right after she uses it on a minion. If Ahri R Spirit Rush is available, account for her ability to create distance after you engage.
Ahri.phase: In the late game, Galio should focus on engaging, providing crowd control, and surviving with magic resistance rather than dealing damage.
Ahri.teamfight: Using Galio R Hero's Entrance as soon as an ally is engaged lets you shield them before you arrive. Land where allied crowd control has caught an enemy to knock them up, then use Galio W Shield of Durand to taunt enemies who are in position to attack your allies. If Ahri E Charm is on cooldown, look for a chance to engage on her too, but protect your allies by blocking narrow entrances with Galio Q Winds of War.

Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range when it hits minions, so don’t stand behind the wave, and dodge both legs of its path. Akshan E Heroic Swing uses walls to engage or escape, so watch your distance near walls. When you’re low on health and Akshan R Comeuppance shows its targeting indicator, get behind terrain to block the shots.
Akshan.build: Akshan’s main damage is physical, and Galio has relatively low armor, so build armor first. Start with Cloth Armor, then choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Akshan.fight: When Akshan’s attack comes in, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to reduce the damage, then retaliate.
Akshan.escape: The moment after Akshan E Heroic Swing goes on cooldown is your chance to engage with Galio E Justice Punch. After closing the distance, taunt with Galio W Shield of Durand to take advantage of the window when Akshan can’t escape with his mobility ability.
Akshan.phase: In the late game, focus on protecting your allies with engages and crowd control rather than dealing damage.
Akshan.teamfight: If Akshan W Going Rogue marks you as a scoundrel, don’t face him alone; fight outside his execute range. If an ally is engaged, use Galio R Hero's Entrance to shield them first, then land where allied crowd control has caught an enemy to knock them up. Follow with Galio W Shield of Durand to taunt enemies who are in position to attack your allies.

Ambessa.watch: When you see the shield and windup of Ambessa W Repudiation, don’t attack; walk out of its range. If Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam is hard to dodge, avoid the blade’s edge and move close to her. If Ambessa E Lacerate hits you, use Galio E Justice Punch to escape instead of waiting for the slow to wear off.
Ambessa.build: Start with Cloth Armor, then choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Ambessa deals mostly physical damage, so build armor first.
Ambessa.fight: Trade right after Ambessa uses her abilities and empowered attacks. When her attack comes in, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to reduce the damage, then retaliate with a taunt after Ambessa W Repudiation’s windup ends.
Ambessa.phase: In the late game, Galio helps his allies with engages and crowd control rather than damage.
Ambessa.teamfight: Ambessa R Public Execution can target your backline, so position yourself to keep Ambessa and your backline from standing in a straight line. If an ally is engaged, cast Galio R Hero's Entrance to shield them first, then after landing, use Galio W Shield of Durand to taunt enemies who are in position to attack your allies.

Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost detonates at the point where it is recast and stuns, so dodge beyond the blast radius instead of only sidestepping the projectile. If you are hit by Anivia Q Flash Frost or chilled inside a fully formed Anivia R Glacial Storm, Anivia E Frostbite deals increased damage, so get out of the storm immediately or use Galio E Justice Punch to create distance. In narrow paths, Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape route.
Anivia.build: Since Anivia’s main damage is magic, prioritize magic resistance and rush Spectre’s Cowl or Spirit Visage. Galio’s magic resistance also helps the damage from Galio P Colossal Smash and Galio R Hero’s Entrance, as well as the damage reduction from Galio W Shield of Durand.
Anivia.fight: Move in right after Anivia uses Anivia Q Flash Frost on a minion, then taunt her with Galio W Shield of Durand. If you land your abilities, follow up with Galio P Colossal Smash’s empowered basic attack. If Anivia P Rebirth is available, go in with your jungler or another ally to destroy the egg.
Anivia.laning: Manage your mana by hitting both the minion wave and Anivia with Galio Q Winds of War. Step forward while Galio W Shield of Durand’s shield is active; if poke breaks it, back off and wait for it to recharge. After pushing the wave toward Anivia’s turret, look for a chance to influence another lane with Galio R Hero’s Entrance.
Anivia.combo: While Anivia Q Flash Frost is unavailable, knock her up with Galio E Justice Punch, then charge Galio W Shield of Durand before the knock-up ends and briefly release it to chain the taunt. Follow with Galio Q Winds of War, placing both gusts where they overlap on Anivia, then use Galio P Colossal Smash’s empowered basic attack.
Anivia.escape: The moment after Anivia uses Anivia Q Flash Frost on a minion is your chance to close the gap. You can engage with Galio E Justice Punch and chain into a Galio W Shield of Durand taunt, but also consider whether you will need to escape after engaging. If Anivia Q Flash Frost hits you, do not keep fighting; use Galio E Justice Punch to dodge the next Anivia E Frostbite.
Anivia.teamfight: Start fights in open areas instead of narrow jungle paths where Anivia W Crystallize can easily block your escape. If an ally is caught, cast Galio R Hero’s Entrance to shield them first, then land where your ally’s crowd control has locked down enemies and knock them up. Follow with Galio W Shield of Durand to taunt enemies in position to threaten your ally, and use Galio Q Winds of War to block narrow entrances.

Annie.watch: When Annie P Pyromania is primed, stay out of Annie’s ability range. Spread out so multiple allies are not hit together by the area attack from Annie R Summon: Tibbers, and keep your distance from Tibbers after it is summoned.
Annie.build: Annie’s damage is magic, so rush Spectre’s Cowl or Spirit Visage to build magic resistance. Magic resistance also helps Galio’s defense and damage, so get enough to survive one burst from Annie.
Annie.fight: Pressure Annie right after she uses her stun. When Annie’s attacks come in, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to reduce the damage, then counterattack with a taunt.
Annie.laning: If Galio W Shield of Durand’s shield is broken, back off and wait for it to recharge. After pushing the lane, look for a chance to influence another lane with Galio R Hero’s Entrance.
Annie.combo: When Annie’s stun is unavailable, knock her up with Galio E Justice Punch, then briefly charge Galio W Shield of Durand and release it before the knock-up ends to chain the taunt. Then cast Galio Q Winds of War so its two gusts overlap on Annie while she is locked down, and hit her with Galio P Colossal Smash’s empowered basic attack.
Annie.escape: The moment Annie has just used Annie P Pyromania’s stun is your chance to engage. Annie has no dash, but Annie E Molten Shield can increase her movement speed, so close the gap and then catch her with Galio W Shield of Durand.
Annie.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging, applying crowd control, and surviving with your magic resistance rather than dealing damage.
Annie.teamfight: If Annie is missing or has her stun primed, do not stand clustered with your allies. If Annie steps forward, use Galio W Shield of Durand to taunt her away from your allies. If an ally is caught, help with the shield and knock-up from Galio R Hero’s Entrance.

AurelionSol.build: Since Aurelion Sol’s main damage is magic, rush Spectre’s Cowl or Spirit Visage to build magic resistance. Galio’s magic resistance also helps the damage from Galio P Colossal Smash and Galio R Hero’s Entrance, as well as the damage reduction from Galio W Shield of Durand. Since Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on maximum health, avoid choices that only add a large amount of health.
AurelionSol.fight: If Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is unavailable, close the gap with Galio E Justice Punch and catch him with Galio W Shield of Durand’s taunt. When Aurelion Sol’s attack comes in, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to reduce the damage, then retaliate with a taunt.
AurelionSol.laning: Hit both the wave and Aurelion Sol with Galio Q Winds of War, but stand behind minions so Aurelion Sol cannot keep hitting you with Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light and stacking Stardust. Move in right after Aurelion Sol uses a main ability on minions. After pushing the lane, look for an angle to influence another lane with Galio R Hero’s Entrance.
AurelionSol.combo: If Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is unavailable, knock him up with Galio E Justice Punch, then charge Galio W Shield of Durand before the knock-up ends and briefly release it to chain the taunt. Follow with Galio Q Winds of War, overlapping both gusts on Aurelion Sol while he is locked down, then hit him with Galio P Colossal Smash’s empowered basic attack.
AurelionSol.escape: The moment after Aurelion Sol uses Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is your window to engage. Close the gap with Galio E Justice Punch or Galio R Hero’s Entrance, then use Galio W Shield of Durand to keep him from escaping. Move away from an area covered by Aurelion Sol E Singularity or the landing spot of an empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, then look for another angle.
AurelionSol.teamfight: Spread out so multiple allies are not hit together by empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, and avoid bunching up in narrow passages. If an ally is caught, cast Galio R Hero’s Entrance immediately to shield them first, then land where your ally’s crowd control has locked down enemies and knock them up. Follow with Galio W Shield of Durand to taunt enemies in position to threaten your ally, and use the vortex from Galio Q Winds of War to block narrow entrances.

Azir.watch: Do not stand for long in the straight line of soldiers created by Azir W Arise!; circle around to approach Azir himself. After Azir Q Conquering Sands moves the soldiers, check their new positions. While Azir R Emperor’s Divide is available, do not enter narrow passages together.
Azir.build: Since Azir’s damage is magic, rush Spectre’s Cowl or Spirit Visage to build magic resistance. Galio’s magic resistance also helps the damage from Galio P Colossal Smash and the damage reduction from Galio W Shield of Durand.
Azir.fight: After Azir Q Conquering Sands moves the soldiers, circle around and take a short trade while they are stationary. If you make Azir use Azir E Shifting Sands, close the gap with Galio E Justice Punch and catch him with Galio W Shield of Durand. When Azir’s attack comes in, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to reduce the damage, then retaliate with a taunt.
Azir.laning: Step forward while Galio W Shield of Durand’s shield is active; if it breaks, back off and wait for it to recharge. Manage your mana by hitting both the minions and Azir with Galio Q Winds of War, and pressure him when the soldiers’ duration ends or Azir runs low on mana.
Azir.combo: Cast Galio Q Winds of War so its vortex forms where Azir will be pushed, then knock him into it with Galio E Justice Punch. When you can catch him, knock him up with Galio E Justice Punch, charge Galio W Shield of Durand while he is airborne, briefly release it to taunt him, then cast Galio Q Winds of War at that spot. After landing your abilities, follow up with Galio P Colossal Smash’s empowered basic attack.
Azir.escape: The moment after Azir uses Azir E Shifting Sands is your chance to close the gap. Approach with Galio E Justice Punch or Galio R Hero’s Entrance, then chain into a Galio W Shield of Durand taunt. If Azir places a soldier beyond a wall, he can use Azir E Shifting Sands toward it, so be ready to block his escape route.
Azir.phase: Azir gets stronger as the game goes on, so in the late game Galio should hold the front line and focus on engaging and applying crowd control.
Azir.teamfight: Engage from multiple directions in an open area so Azir R Emperor’s Divide does not knock multiple allies back together. If an ally is caught, shield them first with Galio R Hero’s Entrance, then land on an enemy caught by your ally’s crowd control and knock them up. Taunt enemies threatening your allies with Galio W Shield of Durand. Use Galio Q Winds of War to block narrow entrances and Galio E Justice Punch to block the direction your opponents may escape.

Aurora.watch: Aurora Q Twofold Hex deals damage again when recalled, and the recall damage increases the more health the target has lost. If you are cursed, move out of the line between Aurora and yourself, and if your health is low, retreat before it returns. After Aurora R Between Worlds appears, leaving it slows you, so either get out before she casts it or decide where you will fight inside.
Aurora.build: Most of Aurora’s damage is magic damage, so rush Spectre’s Cowl or Spirit Visage to increase your magic resistance. Galio’s magic resistance also contributes to his defense and damage, and given Aurora P Spirit Abjuration’s damage based on maximum health, investing heavily in health alone is less efficient.
Aurora.fight: Step forward while Galio W Shield of Durand’s shield is active. When Aurora attacks, charge W to reduce the damage, then retaliate with a taunt. Bait out Aurora E The Weirding, then check whether she still has another mobility ability. When she has fewer ways to escape, close in with Galio E Justice Punch.
Aurora.laning: When your shield is gone, retreat and wait for it to recharge. Only trade right after Aurora uses a key ability on minions. After pushing the lane in, look for a chance to affect another lane with Galio R Hero’s Entrance.
Aurora.combo: When Aurora’s mobility ability is down, knock her up with Galio E Justice Punch. Before the knock-up ends, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to follow up with a brief taunt. Then trap Aurora where the two gusts from Galio Q Winds of War overlap, and land Galio P Colossal Smash’s empowered attack as well.
Aurora.escape: If only Aurora W Across the Veil is down, she can still escape with Aurora E The Weirding or R Between Worlds, so don’t recklessly go too deep. Once Aurora W Across the Veil and E The Weirding are both down, and before R comes back, you have a chance to catch her with Galio E Justice Punch and W Shield of Durand.
Aurora.phase: In the late game, Galio should focus on stopping engages and protecting allies with crowd control rather than dealing damage.
Aurora.teamfight: When an ally is engaged on, cast Galio R Hero’s Entrance to shield them first, then land where your ally’s crowd control has caught the enemy and knock them up. Follow with Galio W Shield of Durand to taunt enemies positioned to catch your ally. Aurora’s W Across the Veil cooldown resets when she gets a takedown, so don’t leave a low-health ally behind. If Aurora uses her leap to engage and no one dies, look for a chance to catch her.

Cassiopeia.watch: If you are hit by Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, create distance while poisoned. If you keep getting hit by Cassiopeia E Twin Fang in that state, the damage increases and Cassiopeia heals. You cannot move with Galio E Justice Punch inside Cassiopeia W Miasma. When you see the cast animation for Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, turn your back to avoid being stunned.
Cassiopeia.build: Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, W Miasma, and E Twin Fang all deal magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Rushing Spectre’s Cowl or Spirit Visage helps you survive, and magic resistance also benefits Galio P Colossal Smash and Galio W Shield of Durand.
Cassiopeia.fight: If Cassiopeia has just used a key ability on minions or cast W Miasma elsewhere, close the distance and catch her with Galio W Shield of Durand. If you are hit by Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, retreat while reducing incoming damage with Galio W Shield of Durand, then fight again once the poison wears off.
Cassiopeia.laning: Manage your mana by hitting both the minions and Cassiopeia with Galio Q Winds of War. Step forward while Galio W Shield of Durand’s shield is active; if poke removes it, retreat and wait for it to recharge. After pushing the wave toward the enemy turret, look for a chance to affect another lane with Galio R Hero’s Entrance.
Cassiopeia.escape: Right after Cassiopeia uses W Miasma elsewhere is your chance to engage with Galio E Justice Punch. If the Miasma is already blocking your path, don’t use your mobility ability on it; go around without stepping into it. If you engage while Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze is still available, turn your back when you see the cast animation.
Cassiopeia.phase: Cassiopeia’s damage over time is strong in the late game, so Galio should focus on surviving, engaging, and applying crowd control.
Cassiopeia.teamfight: Instead of charging straight at Cassiopeia, cut off her path or engage right after Cassiopeia W Miasma is used elsewhere. When an ally is engaged on, cast Galio R Hero’s Entrance to shield them first, then, after landing, catch Cassiopeia with Galio W Shield of Durand and E Justice Punch. Cast Galio Q Winds of War in a narrow passage to block Cassiopeia’s approach.

Corki.watch: If Corki E Gatling Gun hits you, it reduces both your armor and magic resistance, so move to the side instead of staying in front of him. Corki R Missile Barrage also hits around its first target, so don’t hide behind minions; move out of range, especially to avoid being hit by the third missile in quick succession. If Corki Q Phosphorus Bomb hits you while you’re escaping, your position is revealed, so use Galio E Justice Punch without hesitation to create distance.
Corki.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Corki’s primary damage is physical, so build armor first. However, prioritize getting out of the front line while Corki E Gatling Gun is reducing your resistances. Corki P Hextech Munitions’ true damage cannot be blocked by resistances.
Corki.fight: Step forward while Galio W Shield of Durand’s shield is active; when it is gone, retreat and wait for it to recharge. As Corki’s attack comes in, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to reduce the damage, then retaliate with a taunt. When Corki W Valkyrie is down, close the distance with Galio E Justice Punch and fight.
Corki.laning: Manage your mana by hitting both the wave and Corki with Galio Q Winds of War, and engage right after Corki uses a key ability on minions.
Corki.combo: After Corki W Valkyrie is down, cast Galio Q Winds of War where Corki will be pushed, then use Galio E Justice Punch to push him into it. If Galio E Justice Punch knocks him up, charge Galio W Shield of Durand before the knock-up ends to follow with a brief taunt, then overlap Galio Q Winds of War there. After hitting your abilities, land Galio P Colossal Smash’s empowered attack as well.
Corki.escape: The window to go in opens right after you bait out Corki W Valkyrie. Close the distance with Galio E Justice Punch then and follow with a taunt from Galio W Shield of Durand. If you engage while Corki W Valkyrie is available, he can escape over terrain, so wait for him to use it.
Corki.phase: Corki gets stronger as he builds items and can safely use Corki R Missile Barrage from the mid to late game, so it is important to disrupt his farming early. In the late game, Galio should help allies with engages and crowd control rather than damage.
Corki.teamfight: When an ally is engaged on, cast Galio R Hero’s Entrance to shield them before you arrive, then land where your ally’s crowd control has caught the enemy and knock them up. Follow with Galio W Shield of Durand to taunt enemies positioned to catch your ally. Cast Galio Q Winds of War in a narrow passage to block an approach, and use Galio E Justice Punch to block the opposing carry’s escape route.

Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave the marked area to avoid the stun and shield. Step out of the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder. If you see Ekko’s afterimage, Ekko R Chronobreak is ready, so don’t recklessly chase him even if his health is low.
Ekko.build: Rush Spectre’s Cowl or Spirit Visage and build magic resistance to prepare for Ekko’s magic damage. For Galio, magic resistance also helps with Galio P Colossal Smash’s damage, the damage reduction from Galio W Shield of Durand, and Galio R Hero’s Entrance’s damage.
Ekko.fight: Right after Ekko closes in with Ekko E Phase Dive, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to reduce the damage and retaliate with a taunt. If Ekko R Chronobreak is also down, close the distance with Galio E Justice Punch and continue the fight.
Ekko.laning: Hit both the wave and Ekko with Galio Q Winds of War while managing your mana. If Galio W Shield of Durand’s shield is removed, retreat and wait for it to recharge. After pushing the lane in, look for an opportunity to affect another lane with Galio R Hero’s Entrance.
Ekko.combo: Hit Ekko with Galio E Justice Punch to knock him up after he engages with Ekko E Phase Dive. While he is airborne, start charging Galio W Shield of Durand to follow with a brief taunt, then overlap Galio Q Winds of War where Ekko is caught. After hitting your abilities, land Galio P Colossal Smash’s empowered attack as well.
Ekko.escape: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, move out of its range to avoid the stun. It is safer to engage after both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down. If only Ekko E Phase Dive is down, he can still escape with Ekko R Chronobreak, so check whether he has another way to move.
Ekko.phase: In the late game, focus on holding the front line and handling engages and crowd control rather than dealing damage.
Ekko.teamfight: Right after Ekko uses Ekko E Phase Dive to engage on an ally, catch him with Galio W Shield of Durand or Galio E Justice Punch to force out Ekko R Chronobreak or stop his engage. When an ally is engaged on, immediately cast Galio R Hero’s Entrance to shield them, then land where your ally’s crowd control has caught the enemy. After landing, use Galio W Shield of Durand to peel the enemy currently threatening your ally.

Hwei.watch: If Hwei E Subject: Torment roots or displaces you, it’s easy to get hit by the follow-up, so don’t rush your engage while it’s available. If one of Hwei’s abilities hits you, reposition immediately to avoid the second ability and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster deals damage based on your max health, so move out of the marked area.
Hwei.build: Build Spectre’s Cowl or Spirit Visage early and stack magic resistance to prepare for Hwei’s main damage. Magic resistance helps Galio with both defense and damage. Since Hwei Q Subject: Disaster scales with max health, avoid investing heavily in health alone.
Hwei.fight: Engage and trap Hwei with Galio W Shield of Durand right after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used to harass or clear the wave. When Hwei’s combo comes in, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to reduce the damage, then taunt in response.
Hwei.laning: Hit both the minions and Hwei with Galio Q Winds of War while managing your mana. Step forward while Galio W Shield of Durand’s shield is active; back off when it breaks and wait for it to recharge. Only close in right after Hwei uses a main ability on the minions, and usually save Galio E Justice Punch to disengage.
Hwei.combo: For a basic trade, create a Galio Q Winds of War vortex where Hwei will be pushed, then knock him into it with Galio E Justice Punch. If you have a clear chance to engage, knock him up with Galio E Justice Punch, then charge Galio W Shield of Durand before the knock-up ends to briefly taunt him and overlap Galio Q Winds of War. After landing your abilities, follow up with Galio P Colossal Smash’s empowered attack.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no mobility, so the moment after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used is your chance to engage. Close the gap with Galio E Justice Punch and follow with Galio W Shield of Durand’s taunt. Wait if Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available, since it can push you back or root you during your engage.
Hwei.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging, crowd control, and surviving with magic resistance rather than dealing damage.
Hwei.teamfight: Look for a chance to get onto Hwei after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used. If an ally is engaged on, cast Galio R Hero’s Entrance immediately to shield them first, then land on enemies caught by your ally’s crowd control and knock them up. Follow with Galio W Shield of Durand to taunt enemies in a position to catch your ally, and use Galio Q Winds of War across narrow entry routes to block space.

Fizz.watch: Fizz E Playful / Trickster can be used to engage or disengage, so don’t lead with Galio E Justice Punch while it’s available. If Fizz R Chum the Waters’ fish attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark explodes.
Fizz.build: Build Spectre’s Cowl or Spirit Visage early and stack magic resistance to prepare for Fizz’s main damage. Magic resistance helps Galio with defense as well as the damage from Galio P Colossal Smash and Galio R Hero’s Entrance, and the damage reduction from Galio W Shield of Durand.
Fizz.fight: Counterattack with Galio E Justice Punch and Galio W Shield of Durand right after Fizz E Playful / Trickster is used. If Fizz engages first, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to reduce the damage, then taunt in response. If Fizz Q Urchin Strike is still available, he can use it to escape, so don’t rush the chase.
Fizz.laning: Hit both the wave and Fizz with Galio Q Winds of War while managing your mana. Look to trade right after Fizz misses a last hit with an empowered attack from Fizz W Seastone Trident or uses Fizz E Playful / Trickster.
Fizz.phase: In the late game, focus on surviving with magic resistance and handling engages and crowd control rather than dealing damage.
Fizz.teamfight: Stay close to your allies to bait out Fizz E Playful / Trickster, then attack Fizz together after it’s used. If an ally is engaged on, cast Galio R Hero’s Entrance immediately to shield them first, then knock enemies up on landing and use Galio W Shield of Durand to peel enemies threatening your ally. If Fizz R Chum the Waters’ fish attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark explodes.

Diana.watch: Dodge Diana Q Crescent Strike by sidestepping, since it curves as it travels. If it hits and marks you, Diana E Lunar Rush can reset, so use Galio E Justice Punch to create distance. When Diana activates Diana W Pale Cascade, don’t let its shield and orbs hit you; wait until they disappear.
Diana.build: Build Spectre’s Cowl or Spirit Visage early and stack magic resistance to prepare for Diana’s main damage. Magic resistance also benefits Galio by increasing Galio P Colossal Smash’s damage and reducing damage through Galio W Shield of Durand, as well as increasing Galio R Hero’s Entrance’s damage.
Diana.fight: Fight after dodging Diana Q Crescent Strike or when Diana E Lunar Rush is used without a mark. If Diana dives in, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to reduce the damage, then taunt in response. Engage with Galio E Justice Punch after the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade disappear.
Diana.laning: Hit both the minions and Diana with Galio Q Winds of War. If Galio W Shield of Durand’s shield breaks, back off and wait for it to recharge.
Diana.escape: If Diana engages first with Diana E Lunar Rush without a mark from Diana Q Crescent Strike, trap her with Galio W Shield of Durand while she has no mobility to return. If Diana Q Crescent Strike hits and marks you, give up on the engage and create distance.
Diana.phase: In the late game, Galio should focus on engaging, crowd control, and surviving with magic resistance rather than dealing damage.
Diana.teamfight: Keep your team spread out so multiple allies aren’t pulled in by Diana R Moonfall, and use vision to check her flank angles. If Diana engages on an ally, cast Galio R Hero’s Entrance immediately to shield them first, then use Galio W Shield of Durand after landing to peel Diana off.

Kassadin.watch: Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield absorbs Galio’s magic damage, so attack after Q is used. Watch for the slow from Kassadin E Force Pulse and Kassadin R Riftwalk, and don’t force a chase when he can escape with R.
Kassadin.build: Kassadin’s main damage is magic, so build Spectre’s Cowl or Spirit Visage early to stack magic resistance. Galio can use magic resistance to survive while also increasing damage from abilities such as Galio P Colossal Smash.
Kassadin.fight: Counterattack and trap Kassadin with Galio W Shield of Durand when Kassadin Q Null Sphere is used or right after Kassadin R Riftwalk.
Kassadin.laning: Hit both the wave and Kassadin with Galio Q Winds of War while managing your mana, and avoid unnecessary ability use near Kassadin.
Kassadin.escape: At this point, close the gap with Galio E Justice Punch and taunt with Galio W Shield of Durand.
Kassadin.phase: In the mid game, push the wave and use Galio R Hero’s Entrance to impact other lanes. In the late game, focus on crowd control and protection to deal with Kassadin’s stronger engages.
Kassadin.teamfight: Make sure your allied backline isn’t left alone within range of Kassadin R Riftwalk. If an ally is engaged on, cast Galio R Hero’s Entrance to shield them first, then use Galio W Shield of Durand after landing to peel Kassadin off the backline.

Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain-dash to low-health minions to close the gap, so keep your distance when minions are about to die. Watch out for Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun. If you’re trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, wait until the blades disappear.
Irelia.build: Use Cloth Armor to get through the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Irelia’s main damage is physical, so build armor first.
Irelia.fight: As Irelia dashes in with Q Bladesurge, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to reduce the damage, then answer with a taunt. Galio Q Winds of War’s magic damage is also effective against Irelia.
Irelia.laning: Use Galio Q Winds of War to hit both the minions and Irelia while managing your mana. Don’t leave a low-health minion between you and Irelia. If Galio W Shield of Durand’s shield is broken, back off and wait for it to recharge. Push the lane toward the enemy turret, then look for an opening to affect another lane with Galio R Hero’s Entrance.
Irelia.combo: Cast Galio Q Winds of War so its gust overlaps the spot where Irelia will engage, then use Galio E Justice Punch to knock her into it. While she is airborne from Galio E Justice Punch, start charging Galio W Shield of Durand and release it early to chain into a taunt. After landing your abilities, follow up with Galio P Colossal Smash’s empowered basic attack.
Irelia.escape: The moment after Irelia uses Q Bladesurge is your window to engage. If Irelia E Flawless Duet’s stun is also on cooldown, close the gap with Galio E Justice Punch and lock her down with Galio W Shield of Durand.
Irelia.phase: In the late game, help your team with engages and crowd control rather than damage.
Irelia.teamfight: Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet can swing a teamfight, so lock Irelia down first. If an ally is engaged on, cast Galio R Hero’s Entrance to shield them before you land, then use Galio W Shield of Durand to taunt Irelia away from your ally. Look for an angle to land where your ally’s crowd control has caught Irelia.

Leblanc.watch: If the mark from LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice is still on you, her next ability will deal more damage, so back away until it disappears. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, use Galio E Justice Punch to get outside the chain’s range before the root takes hold. Even if LeBlanc P Mirror Image creates a clone, don’t use your abilities immediately; check which one is actually attacking.
Leblanc.build: LeBlanc’s main damage is magic, so build Spectre’s Cowl or Spirit Visage early to increase your magic resistance. Magic resistance also helps Galio’s passive damage, Galio W Shield of Durand’s damage reduction, and Galio R Hero’s Entrance’s damage.
Leblanc.fight: As LeBlanc uses W Distortion to engage, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to reduce the damage, then answer with a taunt. Don’t overchase while LeBlanc can return to her original position. Once her return is complete or has already been used, close in with Galio E Justice Punch.
Leblanc.laning: If Galio W Shield of Durand’s shield is broken, back off and wait for it to recharge. Save Galio E Justice Punch so you can escape LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains. If LeBlanc disappears from vision, alert your team immediately.
Leblanc.escape: The moment after LeBlanc uses W Distortion is your chance to close the gap, but watch for her return while she can still go back to her original position. Once her return is complete or has already been used, engage with Galio E Justice Punch and chain into a taunt with Galio W Shield of Durand. Conversely, if LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, use Galio E Justice Punch to get outside the chain’s range before the root takes hold.
Leblanc.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging, crowd control, and surviving with magic resistance rather than dealing damage.
Leblanc.teamfight: If an ally is engaged on by LeBlanc, start Galio R Hero’s Entrance to shield them before you arrive. Land where your ally’s crowd control has caught LeBlanc to knock her up, then use Galio W Shield of Durand to taunt her away from your ally. Use Galio Q Winds of War to cover narrow entry paths, and Galio E Justice Punch to block the direction enemies are fleeing.

Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame applies an area slow, and the ground effect left by Karma R Mantra-empowered Q explodes again after a short delay. If you’re hit, walk out of the circle immediately. If Karma W Focused Resolve tethers you, you can be rooted after a delay, so create enough distance to break the tether.
Karma.build: Karma’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first and get Spectre’s Cowl or Spirit Visage early. Increasing Galio’s magic resistance also helps Galio P Colossal Smash’s damage and Galio W Shield of Durand’s damage reduction.
Karma.fight: The moment after Karma uses Q Inner Flame on a minion is an opportunity to trade. If Karma W Focused Resolve is available, don’t use Galio E Justice Punch to engage; save it to disengage. Once Karma W Focused Resolve is on cooldown, close the gap and catch her with Galio W Shield of Durand’s taunt.
Karma.laning: Use Galio Q Winds of War to hit both the minions and Karma while managing your mana, and avoid Karma’s poke from behind minions or outside her range. If Galio W Shield of Durand’s shield is broken, back off and wait for it to recharge.
Karma.combo: After Karma W Focused Resolve is on cooldown, knock her up with Galio E Justice Punch. Before the airborne duration ends, charge Galio W Shield of Durand and release it early to chain into a taunt, then overlap Galio Q Winds of War’s vortex on that spot. After landing your abilities, follow up with Galio P Colossal Smash’s empowered basic attack.
Karma.escape: Engage after Karma W Focused Resolve is on cooldown or the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E Inspire has expired. You can also look for an opening right after Karma uses Q Inner Flame on a minion. If Karma W Focused Resolve has tethered you, create distance first to avoid the root.
Karma.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging, crowd control, and surviving with magic resistance rather than dealing damage.
Karma.teamfight: If Karma W Focused Resolve is available, create distance first to make her use it, then engage after the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E Inspire expires. If an ally is engaged on, cast Galio R Hero’s Entrance to shield them first, then land where your ally’s crowd control has caught the enemy to knock them up. Follow with Galio W Shield of Durand to taunt enemies in a position to attack your ally.

Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard pierces through after hitting a minion, so don’t stand in a straight line with your allied minions. Lissandra W Ring of Frost’s root and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb’s stun can leave you taking damage in succession, so start charging Galio W Shield of Durand before her combo lands to reduce the damage. If Lissandra casts Lissandra R Frozen Tomb on herself, she becomes immune to damage, so spread out your attacks until the stasis ends.
Lissandra.build: Lissandra’s main damage is magic, so build Spectre’s Cowl or Spirit Visage early to increase your magic resistance. Galio’s magic resistance contributes to both his durability and damage.
Lissandra.fight: Look to trade right after Lissandra uses Lissandra W Ring of Frost on the wave or misses it. If she has also used Lissandra E Glacial Path, close the gap with Galio E Justice Punch and lock her down with Galio W Shield of Durand. If you immobilize her while Lissandra E Glacial Path is traveling, you can prevent her from recasting it to move.
Lissandra.laning: When Galio W Shield of Durand’s shield breaks, back off and wait for it to recharge, and save Galio E Justice Punch to disengage. After pushing the wave in, look for an opportunity to affect another lane with Galio R Hero’s Entrance.
Lissandra.combo: When Lissandra W Ring of Frost or Lissandra E Glacial Path is down, knock her up with Galio E Justice Punch. Before the airborne duration ends, start charging Galio W Shield of Durand to chain a brief taunt, then place Galio Q Winds of War’s vortex where she is held. After landing your abilities, also get in Galio P Colossal Smash’s empowered attack.
Lissandra.escape: The moment after Lissandra uses Lissandra E Glacial Path is an opportunity to close the gap. If Lissandra W Ring of Frost is also down, go in with Galio E Justice Punch and chain into Galio W Shield of Durand’s taunt.
Lissandra.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging, crowd control, and surviving with magic resistance rather than dealing burst damage.
Lissandra.teamfight: Check whether Lissandra E Glacial Path is available before deciding to engage. If an ally is caught, cast Galio R Hero’s Entrance to shield them first, then land where your allies’ crowd control has held the enemy. After landing, taunt enemies in position to attack your allies with Galio W Shield of Durand, and block narrow entry paths with Galio Q Winds of War.

Lux.build: Lux’s main damage is magic, so build Spectre’s Cowl or Spirit Visage early to increase your magic resistance. Galio’s magic resistance also helps with both durability and damage.
Lux.fight: After Lux Q Light Binding misses, close the gap with Galio E Justice Punch. When her attacks come in, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to reduce the damage and retaliate with a taunt. Lux has no mobility ability, so follow up with a taunt once you get on top of her.
Lux.laning: When Galio W Shield of Durand’s shield breaks, back off and wait for it to recharge. Look to trade right after Lux uses a key ability on the minion wave, and usually save Galio E Justice Punch to disengage.
Lux.combo: After dodging Lux Q Light Binding, knock her up with Galio E Justice Punch. Before the airborne duration ends, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to chain a brief taunt, and aim Galio Q Winds of War’s overlapping area where Lux will be held. Then land one empowered attack from Galio P Colossal Smash.
Lux.escape: The window to engage is right after Lux Q Light Binding misses or is used on a minion. Lux has no mobility ability to create distance, so close in with Galio E Justice Punch and taunt her with Galio W Shield of Durand.
Lux.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging, crowd control, and surviving with magic resistance rather than dealing damage.
Lux.teamfight: Approach spread out so you aren’t caught together by Lux E Lucent Singularity. If an ally is caught, cast Galio R Hero’s Entrance to shield them first, then land where your ally’s crowd control has held the enemy and knock them up. Afterward, taunt enemies in position to attack your allies with Galio W Shield of Durand, and block narrow entry paths with Galio Q Winds of War.

Malzahar.watch: Malzahar Q Call of the Void silences and can stop Galio’s engage, so if you see him cast it, move outside the doorway and hold your abilities. Malzahar R Nether Grasp’s suppression can’t be removed with Galio W Shield of Durand’s shield or Galio E Justice Punch, so don’t pass through areas without vision alone while Malzahar can use R.
Malzahar.build: Build magic resistance first to counter Malzahar’s main damage, and prioritize Spectre’s Cowl or Spirit Visage. Galio’s magic resistance helps with both durability and damage, while Malzahar R Nether Grasp deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid choices that only add a large amount of health.
Malzahar.fight: If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, remove it first with Galio Q Winds of War before engaging. Dodge the silence from Malzahar Q Call of the Void, then close the gap when the summons from Malzahar W Void Swarm disappear and lock him down with Galio E Justice Punch and Galio W Shield of Durand.
Malzahar.laning: Move away from minions afflicted by Malzahar E Malefic Visions to avoid its spread. When Malzahar pushes the wave, remove Malzahar P Void Shift and look for an opportunity to catch him with your jungler.
Malzahar.combo: First remove Malzahar P Void Shift with Galio Q Winds of War. When engaging, knock him up with Galio E Justice Punch, then charge Galio W Shield of Durand while he’s airborne to chain a brief taunt. If Galio Q Winds of War is available again, place its vortex where Malzahar will be held, and also get in Galio P Colossal Smash’s empowered attack.
Malzahar.escape: The window to engage is after dodging the silence from Malzahar Q Call of the Void. If the summons from Malzahar W Void Swarm are already out, clear them first with an area ability, then close the gap with Galio E Justice Punch once they disappear. Malzahar has no ability to create distance, so lock him down with Galio W Shield of Durand once you’re on top of him.
Malzahar.phase: Malzahar grows stronger over time, so pressure him early. In the late game, focus on engaging, crowd control, and surviving rather than dealing damage.
Malzahar.teamfight: If the summons from Malzahar W Void Swarm are out, clear them with an area ability before engaging. If an ally is caught, cast Galio R Hero’s Entrance to shield them first, then land where your allies’ crowd control has held the enemy and knock them up. Follow with Galio W Shield of Durand to taunt enemies in position to attack your allies.

Naafiri.watch: If you’re hit once by Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and afflicted with bleed, create distance until the bleed ends so you don’t get hit by her second Q. While Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, she can’t be targeted, so resume attacking after it ends.
Naafiri.build: Naafiri deals mostly physical damage, so build Cloth Armor first and get Plated Steelcaps. Prioritize armor afterward as well, while also building health. If fights drag on because Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Eviscerate heal her, consider healing reduction.
Naafiri.fight: Step forward while Galio W Shield of Durand’s shield is active, and back off when it breaks until it recharges. When Naafiri goes in, charge W to reduce the damage, then retaliate with a taunt.
Naafiri.laning: After pushing the wave toward the enemy turret, look for an opportunity to affect another lane with Galio R Hero’s Entrance.
Naafiri.combo: Cast Galio Q Winds of War so its vortex forms where Naafiri will be pushed into, then push her into that spot with Galio E Justice Punch. If you have a clear opening, immediately after knocking her up with E and before the airborne duration ends, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to chain a brief taunt, then overlap Q on that spot.
Naafiri.escape: Don’t go in just because Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers is down; also check whether Naafiri E Eviscerate and R Hounds’ Pursuit are available. In particular, look for an opportunity after she uses E and before R comes back, close the gap with Galio E Justice Punch, and taunt her with Galio W Shield of Durand.
Naafiri.phase: In the mid game, keep wide vision to watch for Naafiri’s roams. In the late game, group up for a front-to-front team fight, and protect your allies with Galio’s engage and crowd control.
Naafiri.teamfight: If Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit is ready, don’t go alone; after an ally dies, back off so you aren’t picked off in succession. If an ally is caught, cast Galio R Hero’s Entrance early to shield them, then land where your ally’s crowd control has held the enemy and knock them up. Follow with Galio W Shield of Durand to taunt enemies positioned to attack your allies, and block the entry path with Galio Q Winds of War.

Mel.watch: If Mel W Rebuttal looks ready, hold Galio Q Winds of War until Mel W Rebuttal is down. Sidestep the center of Mel E Solar Snare to avoid the root. If you have been hit by poke several times, watch for the execute from Mel P Searing Brilliance even if you still have health, and wait somewhere safe after a fight until its stacks disappear.
Mel.build: Mel’s main damage is magic, so rush Spectre’s Cowl or Spirit Visage to raise your magic resistance. Magic resistance also helps Galio’s defense and damage. Keep your total health in mind because of the execute from Mel P Searing Brilliance.
Mel.fight: Engage right after Mel uses her main ability on minions, and use Galio Q Winds of War after Mel W Rebuttal is down. When Mel’s attack comes in, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to reduce the damage, then retaliate with a taunt.
Mel.combo: If Mel W Rebuttal is down, cast Galio Q Winds of War where Mel will be pushed, then send her into it with Galio E Justice Punch. For a reliable close-range lockdown, knock her up with Galio E Justice Punch, then charge Galio W Shield of Durand and briefly taunt her before the knock-up ends, overlapping Galio Q Winds of War at that spot. After landing your abilities, follow up with Galio P Colossal Smash’s empowered attack.
Mel.escape: Mel has no mobility, so sidestepping Mel E Solar Snare or waiting until Mel W Rebuttal is down gives you a chance to close the distance. Engage with Galio E Justice Punch and follow with Galio W Shield of Durand’s taunt. While Mel E Solar Snare is available, save Galio E Justice Punch to disengage.
Mel.teamfight: If an ally is caught, cast Galio R Hero’s Entrance to shield them before you arrive. Land where your ally’s crowd control has caught an enemy to knock them up, then use Galio W Shield of Durand to taunt enemies positioned to catch your ally. Cast Galio Q Winds of War in narrow entryways, and use Galio E Justice Punch to block the direction enemies might flee.

Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is more threatening after it hits a target in front, so don’t stand on top of an ally. If Neeko approaches while transformed, the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom may not be visible, so spread out as soon as you suspect her identity. Don’t chase or attack the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter.
Neeko.build: Neeko’s main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance and rush Spectre’s Cowl or Spirit Visage. Magic resistance also improves Galio’s ability to withstand damage and deal it. If the pattern is getting rooted by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs and then dying to Neeko R Pop Blossom, prioritize tenacity.
Neeko.fight: The moment Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down is your chance to engage and trade. When Neeko’s attack comes in, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to reduce the damage, then retaliate with a taunt. When engaging with Galio E Justice Punch, focus on the real Neeko instead of chasing the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter.
Neeko.laning: When Galio W Shield of Durand’s shield breaks, back off and wait for it to recharge. After pushing the lane in, weigh the chance to influence another lane with Galio R Hero’s Entrance against the lane resources you’ll lose while away.
Neeko.combo: When Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down, knock her up with Galio E Justice Punch, then charge Galio W Shield of Durand while she’s airborne and briefly interrupt it to follow with a taunt. Aim Galio Q Winds of War so its two gusts overlap where Neeko will be rooted. After landing your abilities, follow up with Galio P Colossal Smash’s empowered attack.
Neeko.escape: Engage right after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down. If Neeko’s main abilities are still available in lane, save Galio E Justice Punch to disengage.
Neeko.teamfight: If an ally is caught, cast Galio R Hero’s Entrance early to shield them, then taunt enemies positioned to catch your ally with Galio W Shield of Durand after landing.

Qiyana.watch: If Qiyana approaches with the river element, move out of the root range of Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal. Fight in an open area, since having your back to a wall can let Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent push and stun you. If she disappears with the brush element, move into allied vision.
Qiyana.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Qiyana’s main damage is physical, so prioritize armor. Avoid investing heavily in health alone because Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent deals damage based on your maximum health.
Qiyana.fight: Trade when Qiyana has used both Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity and remains in front of you. When her combo comes in, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to reduce the damage, then retaliate with a taunt. After landing your abilities, follow up with an empowered basic attack from Galio P Colossal Smash.
Qiyana.laning: After pushing the lane toward the enemy turret, look for a chance to influence another lane with Galio R Hero’s Entrance.
Qiyana.combo: If Qiyana’s mobility is down, knock her up with Galio E Justice Punch, then start charging Galio W Shield of Durand while she’s airborne and briefly interrupt it to follow with a taunt. Then overlap the whirlwind from Galio Q Winds of War where Qiyana is rooted.
Qiyana.escape: If only Qiyana W Terrashape is down, she can escape with Qiyana E Audacity, so don’t rush your engage. After she has used both mobility abilities, especially before Qiyana E Audacity comes back up, close the distance with Galio E Justice Punch and hold her with Galio W Shield of Durand.
Qiyana.phase: Qiyana is strongest in the mid game, so avoid giving up an advantage in the early and mid game and build armor. In the late game, group with your allies but avoid spots where Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent can detonate against terrain.
Qiyana.teamfight: If an ally is caught, cast Galio R Hero’s Entrance to shield them before you arrive, and land where allied crowd control has caught an enemy to knock them up. Then use Galio W Shield of Durand to taunt enemies positioned to catch your ally. Fight away from walls and narrow passages so you aren’t hit together by Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent.

Orianna.build: Orianna’s main damage is magic, so rush Spectre’s Cowl or Spirit Visage to raise your magic resistance. For Galio, magic resistance helps with defense and also adds to the damage of Galio P Colossal Smash.
Orianna.fight: The moment after Orianna Q Command: Attack sends the ball away from her is your chance to trade. Orianna E Command: Protect’s ongoing defensive stats are unavailable during that window, so hit her with Galio Q Winds of War and, if you can get close, knock her up with Galio E Justice Punch. Keep the trade short instead of taking repeated attacks from Orianna P Clockwork Windup.
Orianna.laning: Manage your mana by hitting both minions and Orianna with Galio Q Winds of War, and back off to wait for Galio W Shield of Durand’s shield to recharge when it breaks. Engage only right after Orianna uses her main ability on minions, and usually save Galio E Justice Punch to disengage.
Orianna.combo: If you can engage right after Orianna Q Command: Attack, knock her up with Galio E Justice Punch. Before the knock-up ends, charge Galio W Shield of Durand and briefly interrupt it to follow with a taunt, overlapping the whirlwind from Galio Q Winds of War at that spot. After landing your abilities, follow up with one empowered attack from Galio P Colossal Smash.
Orianna.escape: When the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance or the forced movement from Orianna R Command: Shockwave is down, you have a window to engage. If the ball is away from Orianna and she has just used Orianna Q Command: Attack, close the distance with Galio E Justice Punch and taunt her with Galio W Shield of Durand. Otherwise, save Galio E Justice Punch to disengage.
Orianna.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging, crowd control, and holding your ground with magic resistance rather than dealing damage.
Orianna.teamfight: Watch the ball’s position rather than Orianna herself, and avoid spots where Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull you in. If an ally is caught, cast Galio R Hero’s Entrance immediately to shield them first, then land where allied crowd control has caught an enemy to knock them up. Follow with Galio W Shield of Durand to taunt enemies who can catch your ally, and use the whirlwind from Galio Q Winds of War to block narrow entryways.

Ryze.watch: If Ryze E Spell Flux hits you, it marks you, upgrades Ryze W Rune Prison into a root, and empowers Ryze Q Overload, so dodge Ryze E Spell Flux first. If you are marked, move away from your allies and keep your distance until the mark disappears. As his combo comes in, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to reduce the damage, then return with a taunt.
Ryze.build: Since Ryze’s main damage is magic, build magic resistance first and rush Spectre’s Cowl or Spirit Visage. Galio’s magic resistance also helps with his passive damage, the damage reduction from Galio W Shield of Durand, and the damage from Galio R Hero’s Entrance.
Ryze.fight: Just after Ryze uses a key ability on a minion, place Galio Q Winds of War where he’ll be pushed by your engage, then knock him up with Galio E Justice Punch and hold him with Galio W Shield of Durand. If you’re taking repeated ranged poke, save Galio E Justice Punch to disengage.
Ryze.laning: Manage your mana by hitting both the wave and Ryze with Galio Q Winds of War. Step forward while Galio W Shield of Durand’s shield is up; if poke breaks it, back off and wait for it to recharge. After pushing the wave under the enemy turret, weigh your chance to affect another lane with Galio R Hero’s Entrance against the lane resources you’ll lose while away.
Ryze.escape: If Ryze E Spell Flux misses, Ryze W Rune Prison slows instead of rooting, giving you a chance to engage. If Ryze casts Ryze R Realm Warp, you can interrupt it with the taunt from Galio W Shield of Durand or the knock-up from Galio E Justice Punch.
Ryze.teamfight: Rather than giving Ryze space to keep damaging you, close in with Galio E Justice Punch or Galio R Hero’s Entrance to limit the time he has to cycle through his combo. If you cast Galio R Hero’s Entrance as an ally is engaged on, you shield them before you arrive; after landing, taunt enemies in positions from which they can currently reach your ally with Galio W Shield of Durand.

Sylas.watch: With Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, the follow-up chains are more dangerous than the first dash. If a chain hits, Sylas pulls himself to you and knocks you up, so save Galio E Justice Punch until you’ve dodged the chains. The crossing point of Sylas Q Chain Lash explodes late, so move out immediately even if the first hit lands.
Sylas.build: Sylas’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Rushing Spectre’s Cowl or Spirit Visage helps you survive and also adds to Galio’s damage and defenses.
Sylas.fight: After dodging Sylas E Abscond / Abduct’s chains, engage before the ability comes back. When Sylas comes in, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to reduce the damage, then return with a taunt. Chain your crowd control before Sylas heals with Sylas W Kingslayer.
Sylas.escape: Dodge the second chain from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, and make sure Sylas W Kingslayer is also down before engaging. If only one mobility ability is down, he can escape with the other, so wait for another chance to close the gap with Galio E Justice Punch or Galio R Hero’s Entrance. Once you engage, hold him with the taunt from Galio W Shield of Durand.
Sylas.phase: In the late game, focus on surviving with magic resistance, engaging, and providing crowd control rather than dealing damage.
Sylas.teamfight: Right after Sylas dives in with Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, hold him with Galio W Shield of Durand or Galio E Justice Punch to give your allies time to attack before he can heal with Sylas W Kingslayer. If an ally is engaged on, cast Galio R Hero’s Entrance to shield them first, then use the taunt after landing to peel enemies threatening them. Stagger your knock-up and taunt to keep enemies held in place.

Syndra.fight: Look to engage right after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down. Reduce incoming damage with Galio W Shield of Durand, then return with a taunt and aim the vortex from Galio Q Winds of War where Syndra will be. After landing your abilities, also get in the empowered attack from Galio P Colossal Smash.
Syndra.laning: Step forward while Galio W Shield of Durand’s shield is up; if it breaks, back off and wait for it to recharge. Engage just after Syndra uses a key ability on a minion, but use Galio E Justice Punch carefully so you can escape poke.
Syndra.escape: Syndra has no mobility, but she can knock you back and stun you with Syndra E Scatter the Weak, so engage right after she uses it. If you see a sphere, first move out of the stun line, then close the gap with Galio E Justice Punch and hold her with Galio W Shield of Durand.
Syndra.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging, crowd control, and surviving with magic resistance rather than dealing damage.
Syndra.teamfight: When Syndra has set up several spheres in an area, decide whether to reposition or risk engaging, keeping Syndra R Unleashed Power in mind. If an ally is engaged on, cast Galio R Hero’s Entrance to shield them first, then aim to land where your ally’s crowd control has held enemies so you can knock them up. Follow with Galio W Shield of Durand to taunt enemies in positions from which they can currently reach your ally.

Talon.watch: Talon W Rake applies stacks of Talon P Blade’s End if it hits on both the outgoing and returning paths, so if the first hit lands, move out of its return path. While Talon R Shadow Assault is available, he can escape with stealth, so don’t chase recklessly.
Talon.build: Early on, use Cloth Armor to withstand Talon’s physical damage and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Build armor first, but also build health if Talon has lethality.
Talon.fight: When Talon engages, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to reduce the damage, then return with a taunt. If Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is down, close the gap with Galio E Justice Punch.
Talon.combo: After Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is down, knock him up with Galio E Justice Punch. Before the knock-up ends, charge Galio W Shield of Durand for a brief taunt, then cast Galio Q Winds of War so its vortex overlaps the spot where Talon is held. Follow with the empowered basic attack from Galio P Colossal Smash.
Talon.escape: Right after Talon uses Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is your chance to engage with Galio E Justice Punch and land the taunt from Galio W Shield of Durand. Talon having already used Talon R Shadow Assault also gives you an opening to counterattack, but keep in mind that he can cross terrain with Talon E Assassin’s Path.
Talon.phase: In the late game, Talon’s influence falls off, so Galio should group with allies and respond with crowd control.
Talon.teamfight: When Talon dives onto your back line, taunt him with Galio W Shield of Durand from a position where he can reach your allies, then knock him up with Galio E Justice Punch. If you cast Galio R Hero’s Entrance as an ally is engaged on, you can shield them before you arrive; aim to land where your ally’s crowd control has caught Talon.

TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card locks in a Gold Card, one basic attack will stun you, so stay out of attack range. Stand behind minions to reduce poke from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.
TwistedFate.build: Twisted Fate’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Prioritizing Spectre’s Cowl or Spirit Visage helps Galio survive and also increases damage that scales with magic resistance.
TwistedFate.fight: Keep your distance while Twisted Fate W Pick a Card has a Gold Card ready. Look for a chance to engage when you see a Blue or Red Card, or right after he uses the Gold Card. As his attack comes in, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to reduce the damage, then retaliate with a taunt.
TwistedFate.laning: Use Galio Q Winds of War to hit both the minions and Twisted Fate while managing your mana. Engage only right after he uses a key ability on the minions, and save Galio E Justice Punch to disengage the rest of the time.
TwistedFate.combo: If Twisted Fate uses his Gold Card, knock him up with Galio E Justice Punch. Before the knock-up ends, charge Galio W Shield of Durand and briefly taunt to extend the crowd control. Fire Galio Q Winds of War so both gusts overlap where he is held.
TwistedFate.escape: The moment after Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s Gold Card is used is your chance to engage.
TwistedFate.phase: In the late game, focus on engaging, crowd control, and surviving with magic resistance rather than dealing damage.
TwistedFate.teamfight: If Twisted Fate has just used his Gold Card, Galio E Justice Punch can close the gap and lock him down. If you see Twisted Fate R Destiny being used and he is in range, interrupt it with Galio W Shield of Durand or Galio E Justice Punch. When an ally is caught, cast Galio R Hero’s Entrance to shield them first, then use Galio W Shield of Durand after landing to peel enemies threatening your ally.

Veigar.watch: Veigar E Event Horizon stuns you when you cross its edge. If trapped inside, move around within it and wait for it to disappear instead of running into the edge. Veigar W Dark Matter shows where it will land, so sidestep it. If your health is below half, move out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst.
Veigar.build: Veigar’s main damage is magic, so prioritize Spectre’s Cowl or Spirit Visage to build magic resistance. For Galio, magic resistance helps with both defense and the damage of Galio P Colossal Smash and Galio R Hero’s Entrance.
Veigar.fight: Close the gap and lock Veigar down with Galio W Shield of Durand after he uses a key ability on the minions or Veigar E Event Horizon is on cooldown. Keep moving during the fight so you can dodge Veigar W Dark Matter.
Veigar.laning: Use Galio Q Winds of War to hit both the wave and Veigar while managing your mana. Veigar Q Baleful Strike only passes through the first two units it hits, so stand behind minions to reduce unnecessary poke. After pushing the lane, look for chances to impact other lanes with Galio R Hero’s Entrance.
Veigar.combo: Knock Veigar up with Galio E Justice Punch, then start charging Galio W Shield of Durand while he is airborne and briefly taunt to extend the crowd control. Follow with Galio Q Winds of War, aiming both gusts to overlap where Veigar is, and land an empowered basic attack from Galio P Colossal Smash.
Veigar.phase: In the late game, Veigar becomes powerful as he gains stacks, so track his position and whether Veigar E Event Horizon is available while fighting.
Veigar.teamfight: When an ally is caught, cast Galio R Hero’s Entrance to shield them first, then land where an enemy is held by your ally’s crowd control and knock them up. Follow with Galio W Shield of Durand to taunt enemies who are positioned to catch your ally. Use Galio Q Winds of War in narrow passages to block entry.

Vex.watch: While Vex P Doom ’n Gloom is ready, don’t dash in with Galio E Justice Punch. Vex E Looming Darkness grows larger the farther it travels, so if it is already in range, dodge a short distance to the side. If hit by Vex R Shadow Surge, move toward your allies to prepare for the follow-up dash.
Vex.build: Vex’s main damage is magic, so prioritize Spectre’s Cowl or Spirit Visage to build magic resistance. Building magic resistance also increases Galio P Colossal Smash’s damage and the damage reduction from Galio W Shield of Durand.
Vex.fight: Engage after Vex P Doom ’n Gloom is used on the wave or for poke, and after Vex W Personal Space is also on cooldown. As Vex’s attack comes in, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to reduce the damage, then retaliate with a taunt. If a dash applies the Gloom mark, move outside Vex’s basic attack range and wait for it to disappear.
Vex.laning: Engage only right after Vex uses a key ability on the minions. When the shield from Galio W Shield of Durand wears off, back away and wait for it to recharge. After pushing the lane toward the enemy turret, look for chances to impact other lanes with Galio R Hero’s Entrance.
Vex.combo: For a basic trade, fire Galio Q Winds of War so it overlaps where Vex will be pushed, then push her into it with Galio E Justice Punch. For a full combo after Vex P Doom ’n Gloom is used, knock her up with Galio E Justice Punch, then charge Galio W Shield of Durand and briefly taunt before the knock-up ends. Follow by overlapping Galio Q Winds of War.
Vex.escape: The window to engage opens after Vex P Doom ’n Gloom is used and Vex W Personal Space is also on cooldown.
Vex.phase: In the late game, focus on surviving with magic resistance and handling engages and crowd control rather than dealing damage.
Vex.teamfight: If an ally is marked by Vex R Shadow Surge, cast Galio R Hero’s Entrance to shield them before you arrive, and aim for where Vex will dash in. Knock her up on landing, then use Galio W Shield of Durand to taunt enemies who are positioned to catch your ally. First move low-health allies outside Vex’s range so she can’t reset her ultimate with an initial takedown.

Vladimir.watch: Vladimir Q Transfusion heals him and grants movement speed when empowered, so keep your distance when he approaches with an empowered Q. When Vladimir E Tides of Blood is charged, put minions between you or move out of range. If afflicted by Vladimir R Hemoplague, you take increased damage, so engage again after the effect ends.
Vladimir.build: Vladimir’s main damage is magic, so prioritize Spectre’s Cowl or Spirit Visage to build magic resistance. Magic resistance helps Galio with both defense and damage. If extended fights make Vladimir’s healing difficult to deal with, get healing reduction after magic resistance.
Vladimir.fight: Look to engage when Vladimir charges Vladimir E Tides of Blood and is slowed, or right after he uses a key ability on the minions. As Vladimir’s attack comes in, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to reduce the damage, then retaliate with a taunt.
Vladimir.laning: After pushing the lane toward the enemy turret, look for an opportunity to impact other lanes with Galio R Hero’s Entrance.
Vladimir.combo: First, place Galio Q Winds of War so it overlaps where Vladimir will be pushed, then push him into it with Galio E Justice Punch. After Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is used, knock him up with Galio E Justice Punch, then start charging Galio W Shield of Durand while he is airborne and briefly taunt to extend the crowd control. Follow by overlapping Galio Q Winds of War and landing an empowered basic attack from Galio P Colossal Smash.
Vladimir.phase: In the mid game, push the wave and use Galio R Hero’s Entrance to impact other lanes. Vladimir becomes harder to deal with as the game goes on, so build an advantage early. In the late game, Galio should focus on engaging, crowd control, and surviving rather than damage.
Vladimir.teamfight: Spread out so multiple allies aren’t hit by Vladimir R Hemoplague, and if infected, step back until the effect ends. When an ally is caught, cast Galio R Hero’s Entrance to shield them first, then land where your ally’s crowd control holds an enemy. After landing, taunt enemies threatening your ally with Galio W Shield of Durand.

Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray travels in a straight line, so stand to the side of the wave and dodge sideways. Viktor W Gravity Field stuns you if you stay inside too long, so leave as soon as it appears and don’t keep trading inside it. Viktor R Arcane Storm interrupts channels when it appears, so be careful when casting Galio R Hero's Entrance.
Viktor.build: Since Viktor Q Siphon Power, E Hextech Ray, and R Arcane Storm all deal magic damage, build Spectre's Cowl or Spirit Visage early to increase your magic resistance. Galio also benefits from magic resistance through Galio P Colossal Smash damage, W Shield of Durand damage reduction, and R Hero's Entrance damage.
Viktor.fight: When Viktor W Gravity Field appears, leave instead of fighting inside it. Viktor has no dash, but Viktor Q Siphon Power can increase his movement speed, so catch him with Galio W Shield of Durand's taunt when you close the gap.
Viktor.laning: When Galio W Shield of Durand's shield breaks, back off and wait for it to recharge. Don’t stand in a line with the wave so you can dodge Viktor E Hextech Ray. After pushing the wave under Viktor's turret, look for an angle to affect another lane with Galio R Hero's Entrance.
Viktor.combo: When Viktor W Gravity Field is down and you can engage, knock him up with Galio E Justice Punch. Before the airborne duration ends, charge Galio W Shield of Durand and briefly release it to continue with a taunt. Overlap Galio Q Winds of War where Viktor will be held. After landing your abilities, also use the empowered basic attack from Galio P Colossal Smash.
Viktor.escape: When Viktor W Gravity Field is down, use Galio E Justice Punch to close the gap. If Gravity Field is placed, leave its area first, then engage right after Viktor uses E Hextech Ray on the wave. Viktor has no dash, so once you’re on him, hold him with Galio W Shield of Durand's taunt.
Viktor.phase: Viktor P Glorious Evolution's growth is permanent, so keep him pressured early. In the late game, Galio takes on the role of engaging, applying crowd control, and surviving with magic resistance.
Viktor.teamfight: When an ally is engaged on, cast Galio R Hero's Entrance to shield them before you arrive, then land where your ally's crowd control is holding Viktor and knock him up. Follow with Galio W Shield of Durand to taunt enemies positioned to attack your ally. If you’re on Viktor, move so you don’t step into Viktor W Gravity Field's area.

Xerath.watch: If Xerath E Shocking Orb stuns you, you can easily be hit by a string of follow-up attacks, so be especially careful of that shot. Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so move well to the side when you see him charging it. Leave the marked area to dodge the slow from Xerath W Eye of Destruction as well.
Xerath.build: Xerath's main damage is magic, so build Spectre's Cowl or Spirit Visage early to increase your magic resistance. Magic resistance also helps Galio's passive damage, Galio W Shield of Durand's damage reduction, and Galio R Hero's Entrance damage. Still, your priority is dodging Xerath E Shocking Orb so you don’t get stunned and hit by a chain of attacks.
Xerath.fight: Close the gap and fight just after Xerath E Shocking Orb and W Eye of Destruction are down. You can also dodge to the side and approach while Xerath charges Q Arcanopulse. Once you’re on him, taunt with Galio W Shield of Durand so Xerath can’t walk away.
Xerath.laning: Step forward while Galio W Shield of Durand's shield is up. When it breaks, back off and wait for it to recharge. Manage your mana by hitting both the wave and Xerath with Galio Q Winds of War, and look to trade right after Xerath uses an ability on minions.
Xerath.combo: If Xerath E Shocking Orb is down, knock him up with Galio E Justice Punch. Before the airborne duration ends, charge Galio W Shield of Durand and briefly release it to continue with a taunt. Cast Galio Q Winds of War so its two gusts overlap where Xerath is held. Follow with an empowered basic attack from Galio P Colossal Smash.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility, so the moment after Xerath E Shocking Orb and W Eye of Destruction are down is your chance to engage. Close the gap with Galio E Justice Punch and hold him with Galio W Shield of Durand's taunt. While both abilities are available, save Galio E Justice Punch to disengage.
Xerath.teamfight: When an ally is engaged on, start casting Galio R Hero's Entrance to shield them before you arrive, then knock enemies up on landing. Follow with Galio W Shield of Durand to taunt enemies positioned to attack your ally. If you see Xerath R Rite of the Arcane's cast animation, dodge immediately and look for an opportunity to engage while Xerath can’t move.

Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, he is preparing his tornado, so stay out of range until the stacks expire. When he dives in with Yone E Soul Unbound, he can deal extra damage on his return, so retreat before your health gets low. In team fights, check your formation so multiple players aren’t lined up along the path of Yone R Fate Sealed.
Yone.build: First, get enough movement speed to leave the range of Yone's telegraphed attacks. Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so build both resistances instead of focusing on just one. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone.
Yone.fight: Keep your distance while Yone prepares his tornado. After he engages with Yone E Soul Unbound, hold Galio W Shield of Durand to counter him. Charge Galio W Shield of Durand to reduce the damage you take, then retaliate with its taunt. If Yone still has several mobility abilities, don’t chase immediately just because he used one.
Yone.laning: Manage your mana by hitting both the minions and Yone with Galio Q Winds of War, and back off when Yone Q Mortal Steel's tornado stacks are ready.
Yone.combo: After Yone engages, knock him up with Galio E Justice Punch. While he’s airborne, start charging Galio W Shield of Durand and briefly release it to continue with a taunt. Then cast Galio Q Winds of War so both gusts overlap where Yone is held. If your abilities hit, also use the empowered basic attack from Galio P Colossal Smash.
Yone.escape: The opportunity to engage comes when Yone Q Mortal Steel's tornado stacks expire and Yone E Soul Unbound or R Fate Sealed is down. In particular, before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back, close the gap with Galio E Justice Punch and taunt with Galio W Shield of Durand. If Yone engages first in spirit form, you can stop his return with a taunt or knock-up.
Yone.phase: In the late game, protect your allies with engages and crowd control rather than trying to outdamage the enemy.
Yone.teamfight: Spread out so Yone W Spirit Cleave doesn’t hit several allies at once, and check who is at the back of the formation reached by Yone R Fate Sealed. When an ally is engaged on, cast Galio R Hero's Entrance to shield them first, then land where your ally's crowd control is holding Yone and knock him up. Follow with Galio W Shield of Durand to taunt Yone if he is positioned to attack your ally.

Zed.watch: Track the position of Zed W Living Shadow and move outside the range of Zed E Shadow Slash cast from the shadow to avoid its slow. If Zed R Death Mark is applied to you, taunt him with Galio W Shield of Durand before he can stack more damage to interrupt his combo.
Zed.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Zed's main damage from Q Razor Shuriken, E Shadow Slash, and R Death Mark is physical, so build armor first. Zed P Contempt for the Weak deals magic damage based on your maximum health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone.
Zed.fight: Engage after Zed uses W Living Shadow, once the shadow disappears or Zed has already repositioned. Place Galio Q Winds of War where Zed will be pushed in, then use Galio E Justice Punch to push him into it. When Zed's combo comes in, charge Galio W Shield of Durand to reduce the damage, then retaliate with its taunt.
Zed.laning: Step forward while Galio W Shield of Durand's shield is up. When it breaks, back off and wait for it to recharge. Hit both the wave and Zed with Galio Q Winds of War, then after pushing the lane, look for an angle to affect another lane with Galio R Hero's Entrance.
Zed.combo: When Zed's mobility is down, knock him up with Galio E Justice Punch.
